info.name: SmartQueue Platform API
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the SmartQueue & Appointment Management Platform backend (Spring Boot 4.1.1, REST API v1). Covers health, authentication, registration, onboarding, branch/service/counter/staff management, working hours/holidays, appointment booking, queue processing, staff counter operations, notifications, analytics, platform administration, and security/tenant-isolation checks.

request.description: Returns UP when all underlying infrastructure (PostgreSQL, Redis) is operational.
Registers a platform-level customer account with no organization context. Returns verificationRequired: true and dispatches verification email.
Submits a business application (organization + initial branch + owner account + inactive owner membership). Requires platform admin review for activation.
Exchanges email and password for a short-lived Bearer JWT (1h expiration). Automatically saves customerToken and organizationId to environment variables.
Consumes the single-use verification token received via email (retrieved from Mailpit in local dev).
Dispatches a fresh verification email if the account has a pending verification token.
Triggers password recovery email if the account exists.
Consumes password reset token and sets new password. Retires all prior active sessions.
Changes password for the currently authenticated user and revokes all other sessions.

Lists ACTIVE branches belonging to the specified ACTIVE organization.
Lists ACTIVE services belonging to the specified branch.
Reads organization details for authorized members.
Returns the status of the caller's business application (PENDING_APPROVAL, ACTIVE, REJECTED).
Lists branches belonging to the caller's organization (paginated, sortable, status filter).
Creates a new branch under the caller's organization (requires MANAGER or ADMIN role). Automatically captures branchId from Location header.
Retrieves branch details by ID.
Replaces mutable branch fields (requires MANAGER or ADMIN role).
Activates a branch (idempotent).
Deactivates a branch (idempotent).
Lists services for the specified branch.
Creates a new service under the branch. Captures serviceId.
Reads service details by ID.
Updates service details.
Activates a service.
Deactivates a service.
Lists counters for the branch.
Creates a counter under the branch. Captures counterId.
Reads counter details by ID.
Updates counter name.
Activates a counter.
Deactivates a counter.
Lists services that this counter is capable of serving.
Associates a service capability with the counter (same branch enforced).
Removes the service capability association from the counter.
Lists users in the organization (MANAGER/ADMIN).
Creates an operational staff or manager user in the organization.
Reads user profile and roles.
Updates user profile and roles.
Activates user account.
Deactivates user account (prevents login).
Lists branch assignments for a user.
Assigns user to a branch.
Lists branch staff roster.
Lists pending and historical invitations for the organization.
Invites a staff or manager to the organization.
Accepts an invitation, creating user account and active membership.
Lists weekly working hours for a branch.
Sets working hours for a specific day of the week.
Lists holidays for a branch.
Adds a holiday date when booking and queues are closed.
Calculates available time slots for booking on a given date.
Books an appointment race-safely (no double booking). Captures appointmentId.
Role-routed list of appointments for the caller.

Cancels an active appointment.

Lists in-app notifications for the authenticated user.

Operational summary analytics (measured waits and durations).
Lists pending organization applications for platform administrators.
Approves organization and owner membership atomically (requires PLATFORM_ADMIN authority).
Rejects organization application with applicant-facing feedback.
Tests that unauthenticated requests to protected endpoints return 401 UNAUTHENTICATED.
Tests tenant isolation and scope enforcement.
